description: Field-level dropout rates based on real ADNI missing data analysis
note: Used for field-level dropout in Stage3Dataset. Demographics/cognition/genetics only. Prior DX and region labels use separate perturbation/dropout mechanism.

raw_missing_rates._comment: Actual missing rates from ADNIMERGE full table (16,421 rows)

stage1_missing_rates._comment: Missing rates in our FS-filtered stage1 dataset (4,997 samples)

dropout_rates._comment: Recommended field-level dropout probabilities. Based on ADNIMERGE rates with 5% floor for demographics robustness.
